## 中文版本说明

### 招投标工作流

- 新增资信库，在本地集中维护企业资料、资质证书、人员、项目业绩及相关图片。
- 技术方案与已有方案扩写新增按原文证据识别多标段、选择本次投标范围的能力；保留通用条款，并在切换范围时清理失效的下游生成结果。
- 新增生成设置步骤，可设置全文最低字数、参考上限、每节参考字数和事实缺失处理方式；正文生成支持更多 AI 配图风格。
- 优化已有方案扩写的文件区与投标范围入口，增加正文预览空间；章节预览支持直接渲染 Mermaid 图，正文页增加单节 Word 预览。

### 导出与可靠性

- 修正招投标 Word 模板的正文及标题首行字符缩进和段落间距写入；导出后可检查空白页等版式问题。
- 修复加密 API Key 被重复加密时导致模型请求失败的问题，并保护损坏的配置文件不被覆盖。
- 修复继续生成正文时已有内容与任务状态不一致导致的停滞，并对未完成小节给出明确状态。
- 可研报告新增可选的生成后自动审校，以及编制信息页、项目基本情况附表的导出选项；用量统计增加缓存 Token 记录。

## English Release Notes

### Bid Workflows

- Added a local credential library for company details, certificates, personnel, project references, and related images.
- Added evidence-based identification and selection of tender lots in Technical Plan and Existing Plan Expansion. Shared requirements are retained, while downstream results invalidated by a scope change are cleared.
- Added generation settings for minimum total length, a reference upper limit, per-section length, and missing-fact handling. Body generation now supports more AI illustration styles.
- Refined the file area and tender-scope control in Existing Plan Expansion to give the document preview more room. Chapter previews render Mermaid diagrams, and the body editor offers a Word preview for individual sections.

### Export and Reliability

- Fixed character-based first-line indents and paragraph spacing in bid Word templates. Exported documents can now be checked for layout issues such as blank pages.
- Fixed model request failures caused by repeatedly encrypted API keys, while keeping damaged configuration files from being overwritten.
- Fixed stalled body generation when existing content and task status disagree, and made incomplete sections visible in task results.
- Added optional automatic review after Feasibility Report generation, export options for a preparation page and project summary appendix, and cached-token usage tracking.
